title: Wayland crash with libdecor and rendering Blender location dialog
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: `4.6.2-stable` and newer, including latest 
- Not reproducible in: `4.6.2-rc2` and older
- Narrowed down to eb680bc (which was cherry-picked as c563a1f into `4.6.2`)

### System information

Godot v4.7.beta (dff2b9bb6) - Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER (nvidia; 580.159.03) - AMD Ryzen 7 7700 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 61.94 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Godot crashes under Wayland with libdecor if your project has `.blend` assets and it cannot find Blender, specifically when trying to render the borderless window popup saying as much.

Running with `GODOT_WAYLAND_DISABLE_LIBDECOR=1` does *not* crash.

Running with `X11` as the display driver also does not crash.

Introduced with eb680bc . Those changes are great, they just missed this borderless window timing scenario. I have a pull request queued that fixes it for me.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Do not have Blender installed (or at least not where Godot can find it)
2. Start Godot with Wayland as the display driver (e.g. `./godot --display-driver wayland`)
3. Create a new project
4. Add any Blender assets (`.blend`)
5. Crash

Or just open the MRP as step 3:

`./godot --display-driver wayland --editor --path ~/wayland-zero-geometry-repro`

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[wayland-zero-geometry-repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28444355/wayland-zero-geometry-repro.zip)
